title: ModelOps · Rollouts
description: Canary rollouts as the router and the control loop see them.

panels.title: Predictions / s
panels.description: Requests the router sent to a model version, all versions of the selected model(s).

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: 5xx share of routed predictions. The default rollback gate is 5% above the stable version.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: Router to model service round trip, 95th percentile.

panels.title: Live rollouts
panels.description: Active, automation-enabled rollouts the worker saw on its last sweep.

panels.title: Decisions in range
panels.description: Rollouts that reached a decision in the selected time range, counted by the control plane since it last started.

panels.title: Worker heartbeat
panels.description: Seconds since the control loop last finished a sweep. Red means rollouts aren't being evaluated.

panels.title: Decisions
panels.description: Promotions, rollbacks and inconclusive freezes, split by whether the worker or an operator decided.

panels.title: Policy verdicts
panels.description: Overall verdict of each policy evaluation the worker requested.

panels.title: Failing checks by policy
panels.description: Which gates fail most often in the selected range.

defaults.noValue: No failed checks in this range

panels.title: Worker actions
panels.description: What the worker did after each evaluation.

panels.title: Sweep duration
panels.description: Time for one pass over every active rollout, with the number of rollouts it had to look at (right axis).

panels.title: Router reconcile
panels.description: Desired (DB) vs observed (router) comparisons per model. 'corrected' means the reconciler repaired drift; red means it couldn't.

panels.title: Traffic split
panels.description: Share of traffic the router sends to each version, as applied (observed state). Each step is a rollout stage, a promote or a rollback.

panels.title: Requests by version
panels.description: Routed predictions per second, by the version that served them.

panels.title: p95 latency by version
panels.description: Router-measured round trip to each version. Solid: p95, dashed: p50. Red line: 500 ms, where the latency alert fires. Click a series for its traces.

panels.title: Error rate by version
panels.description: 5xx share per version. Red line: 5%, where the error alert fires.

targets.expr: (sum by (version) (rate(modelops_router_requests_total{model=~"$model", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (version) (rate(modelops_router_requests_total{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (version) (rate(modelops_router_requests_total{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Every routed request, bucketed by latency. A canary with a slow tail shows up as a second band above the main one.

panels.title: Responses by status
panels.description: Routed predictions by version and HTTP status.
